payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the NCEL approach outperforms other models in terms of performance metrics and efficiency, suggesting its overall effectiveness.

claims.text: NCEL achieves the best performance in most cases with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% on Macro F1 compared to global models.
NCEL is efficient for large-scale data due to its use of batch techniques and GPUs.
The model has been evaluated on five public benchmarks, verifying its linking precision and generalization ability.
